answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 160669 Country: India Title: Sometimes a sticky fluid comes out after urinating. Does this nullify the ghusl or not? Question: Sometimes a sticky fluid comes out after urinating. Does this nullify the ghusl or not? Answer ID: 160669 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 909/872/M=8/1439) The fluid which usually comes after urination is wadi or madhi and they (wadi, madhi) don’t make ghusl wajib. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
